_meta.purpose: Language-neutral checksum contract for the Bitfinex order-book CRC (SPEC-004 / docs/adr/ADR-007-checksum-numeric-token-contract.md). A future implementation in any language can fold these levels and reproduce the exact wire string and signed 32-bit CRC-32.
_meta.source: Algorithm: https://docs.bitfinex.com/docs/ws-websocket-checksum ; numeric-token contract: docs/adr/ADR-007-checksum-numeric-token-contract.md ; live probe 5 July 2026 (8/8 platform checksums reproduced).
_meta.recipe: Apply each [price, count, amount] level (count>0 add/update, amount sign picks the side: bids>0). Take top 25 bids (price desc) and top 25 asks (price asc), interleave bid,ask,bid,ask..., serialise each as plainDecimal(price):plainDecimal(amount), join with ':', CRC-32 (poly 0xEDB88320), return signed 32-bit.

cases.name: sub-tick two-level (exponent-form values exercise the plain-decimal token contract)
